verdict.rationale: Increase is API-first banking infrastructure with documented REST endpoints for money movement (POST /ach_transfers, POST /wire_transfers), programmatic account-number management, event retrieval via webhooks or the List Events API, and a full sandbox with simulation APIs. Probes confirm a public OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, markdown docs and an official CLI, and community commenters, including an Increase engineer, describe the REST API design favorably. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of driving the API end-to-end, documentation of authentication/API-key scoping in the evidence.
